Package ControlClass

Class WithdrawalManager

java.lang.Object
ControlClass.WithdrawalManager
public class WithdrawalManager extends Object
Manages withdrawal requests lifecycle: creation, approval, rejection and side-effects on applications and opportunities.

      public WithdrawalRequest requestWithdrawal(Student student, Application application, String reason)

      application - the target application
